stem: CypherNet must insert third-party firewalls inline between VPCs and scale appliance capacity as traffic grows. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Application Load Balancer with path rules
Gateway Load Balancer as the traffic insertion point
Network Load Balancer with static IP addresses
Register firewall appliances in Gateway Load Balancer target groups

rationale: Gateway Load Balancer is built for virtual appliance insertion and traffic steering at network layer behavior. Registering firewall appliances in GWLB target groups supports scalable appliance fleets. Application Load Balancer focuses on Layer 7 HTTP routing and is not the intended inline security insertion model. Network Load Balancer can provide high-performance transport balancing but does not provide the same appliance insertion workflow. Global Accelerator optimizes global entry routing, not inline firewall service chaining.
